data.raw_text:
FARMERS PROTEST

IN PHOTOS │Farmers led by the Kilusang Magbubukid ng Pilipinas (KMP) from Central Luzon and Southern Tagalog hold a program in front of the Department of Agrarian Reform along Elliptical Road on Tuesday morning, October 21, marking the sixth day of their camp-out protest. After a brief program, which includes the burning of an effigy, the group prepares to stage a caravan to Liwasang Bonifacio in Manila to join a large-scale demonstration. From there, they march to Mendiola to denounce alleged widespread corruption in government flood control and farm-to-market road projects, and to call for genuine agrarian reform.

📸: Edd Castro
